description: Get facts for a specific Azure Front Door (AFD) Rule or all AFD Rules in a Ruleset.

parameters.name: ad_user
parameters.description: Active Directory username. Use when authenticating with an Active Directory user rather than service principal.

parameters.name: adfs_authority_url
parameters.description: Azure AD authority url. Use when authenticating with Username/password, and has your own ADFS authority.

parameters.name: api_profile
parameters.description: Selects an API profile to use when communicating with Azure services. Default value of latest is appropriate for public clouds; future values will allow use with Azure Stack. Default: "latest"

parameters.name: auth_source
parameters.description: Controls the source of the credentials to use for authentication. Can also be set via the ANSIBLE_AZURE_AUTH_SOURCE environment variable. When set to auto (the default) the precedence is module parameters -> env -> credential_file -> cli. When set to env, the credentials will be read from the environment variables When set to credential_file, it will read the profile from ~/.azure/credentials. When set to cli, the credentials will be sources from the Azure CLI profile. subscription_id or the environment variable AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID can be used to identify the subscription ID if more than one is present otherwise the default az cli subscription is used. When set to msi, the host machine must be an azure resource with an enabled MSI extension. subscription_id or the environment variable AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID can be used to identify the subscription ID if the resource is granted access to more than one subscription, otherwise the first subscription is chosen. The msi was added in Ansible 2.6. Choices: "auto" ← (default) "cli" "credential_file" "env" "msi"

parameters.name: cert_validation_mode
parameters.description: Controls the certificate validation behavior for Azure endpoints. By default, all modules will validate the server certificate, but when an HTTPS proxy is in use, or against Azure Stack, it may be necessary to disable this behavior by passing ignore. Can also be set via credential file profile or the AZURE_CERT_VALIDATION environment variable. Choices: "ignore" "validate"

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Azure client ID. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal or Managed Identity (msi). Can also be set via the AZURE_CLIENT_ID environment variable.

parameters.name: cloud_environment
parameters.description: For cloud environments other than the US public cloud, the environment name (as defined by Azure Python SDK, eg, AzureChinaCloud, AzureUSGovernment), or a metadata discovery endpoint URL (required for Azure Stack). Can also be set via credential file profile or the AZURE_CLOUD_ENVIRONMENT environment variable. Default: "AzureCloud"

parameters.name: disable_instance_discovery
parameters.description: Determines whether or not instance discovery is performed when attempting to authenticate. Setting this to true will completely disable both instance discovery and authority validation. This functionality is intended for use in scenarios where the metadata endpoint cannot be reached such as in private clouds or Azure Stack. The process of instance discovery entails retrieving authority metadata from https://login.microsoft.com/ to validate the authority. By setting this to **True**, the validation of the authority is disabled. As a result, it is crucial to ensure that the configured authority host is valid and trustworthy. Set via credential file profile or the AZURE_DISABLE_INSTANCE_DISCOVERY environment variable. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: log_mode
parameters.description: Parent argument.

parameters.name: log_path
parameters.description: Parent argument.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the delivery rule which is unique within the endpoint.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Active Directory user password. Use when authenticating with an Active Directory user rather than service principal.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Security profile found in ~/.azure/credentials file.

parameters.name: profile_name
parameters.description: Name of the Azure Front Door Standard or Azure Front Door Premium profile which is unique within the resource group

parameters.name: resource_group
parameters.description: Name of the Resource group within the Azure subscription.

parameters.name: rule_set_name
parameters.description: Name of the rule set under the profile.

parameters.name: secret
parameters.description: Azure client secret. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

parameters.name: subscription_id
parameters.description: Your Azure subscription Id.

parameters.name: tenant
parameters.description: Azure tenant ID. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

parameters.name: thumbprint
parameters.description: The thumbprint of the private key specified in x509_certificate_path. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal. Required if x509_certificate_path is defined.

parameters.name: x509_certificate_path
parameters.description: Path to the X509 certificate used to create the service principal in PEM format. The certificate must be appended to the private key. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

examples:
- name: Get facts for all Rules in the AFD Profile
  azure_rm_afdrule_info:
    rule_set_name: myRuleset
    profile_name: myProfile
    resource_group: myResourceGroup

- name: Get facts of specific AFD Rule
  azure_rm_afdrule_info:
    name: myRule1
    rule_set_name: myRuleset
    profile_name: myProfile
    resource_group: myResourceGroup

return_values.name: afdrules
return_values.description: List of AFD Rules. Returned: always

return_values.name: actions
return_values.description: A list of actions that are executed when all the conditions of a rule are satisfied. Returned: success

return_values.name: cache_behavior
return_values.description: Caching behavior for the requests. Returned: success

return_values.name: cache_duration
return_values.description: The duration for which the content needs to be cached. Allowed format is [d.]hh:mm:ss. Returned: success

return_values.name: custom_fragment
return_values.description: Fragment to add to the redirect URL. Fragment is the part of the URL that comes after Returned: success

return_values.name: custom_hostname
return_values.description: Host to redirect. Leave empty to use the incoming host as the destination host. Returned: success

return_values.name: custom_path
return_values.description: The full path to redirect. Path cannot be empty and must start with /. Leave empty to use the incoming path as destination path. Returned: success

return_values.name: custom_query_string
return_values.description: The set of query strings to be placed in the redirect URL. Setting this value would replace any existing query string; leave empty to preserve the incoming query string. Query string must be in <key>=:code:<value> format. ? and & will be added automatically so do not include them. Returned: success

return_values.name: destination
return_values.description: Define the relative URL to which the above requests will be rewritten by. Returned: success

return_values.name: destination_protocol
return_values.description: Protocol to use for the redirect. Returned: success

return_values.name: forwarding_protocol
return_values.description: Protocol this rule will use when forwarding traffic to backends. Returned: success

return_values.name: header_action
return_values.description: Action to perform. Returned: success

return_values.name: header_name
return_values.description: Name of the header to modify. Returned: success

return_values.name: is_compression_enabled
return_values.description: The caching configuration for this route. Indicates whether content compression is enabled on AzureFrontDoor. If compression is enabled, content will be served as compressed if user requests for a compressed version. Content won’t be compressed on AzureFrontDoor when requested content is smaller than 1 byte or larger than 1 MB. Returned: success

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: The name of the action for the delivery rule. Returned: success

return_values.name: origin_group
return_values.description: defines the OriginGroup that would override the DefaultOriginGroup. Returned: success

return_values.name: preserve_unmatched_path
return_values.description: Whether to preserve unmatched path. Returned: success

return_values.name: query_parameters
return_values.description: query parameters to include or exclude (comma separated). Returned: success

return_values.name: query_string_caching_behavior
return_values.description: The caching configuration for this route. Defines how Frontdoor caches requests that include query strings. You can ignore any query strings when caching, ignore specific query strings, cache every request with a unique URL, or cache specific query strings. Returned: success

return_values.name: redirect_type
return_values.description: The redirect type the rule will use when redirecting traffic. Returned: success

return_values.name: source_pattern
return_values.description: Define a request URI pattern that identifies the type of requests that may be rewritten. If value is blank, all strings are matched. Returned: success

return_values.name: value
return_values.description: Value for the specified action. Returned: success

return_values.name: conditions
return_values.description: A list of conditions that must be matched for the actions to be executed. Returned: success

return_values.name: match_values
return_values.description: The match value for the condition of the delivery rule. Returned: success

return_values.name: negate_condition
return_values.description: Describes if this is a negate condition or not. Returned: success

return_values.name: operator
return_values.description: Describes operator to be matched. Returned: success

return_values.name: selector
return_values.description: Name of item to be matched. Returned: success

return_values.name: transforms
return_values.description: List of transforms. Returned: success

return_values.name: match_processing_behavior
return_values.description: If this rule is a match should the rules engine continue running the remaining rules or stop. Returned: success

return_values.name: order
return_values.description: The order in which the rules are applied for the endpoint. A rule with a lesser order will be applied before a rule with a greater order. Rule with order 0 is a special rule. It does not require any condition and actions listed in it will always be applied. Returned: success

return_values.name: profile_name
return_values.description: Name of the Azure Front Door Standard or Azure Front Door Premium profile which is unique within the resource group. Returned: success

return_values.name: resource_group
return_values.description: Name of the Resource group within the Azure subscription. Returned: success

return_values.name: rule_set_name
return_values.description: Name of the rule set under the profile. Returned: success

return_values.name: state
return_values.description: Assert the state of the CDN profile. Use present to create or update a CDN profile and absent to delete it. Returned: success

return_values.name: type
return_values.description: Resource type. Returned: success
